title: Implement archived Plant retention and authorized history access filters

gates.name: archive retention access tests
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/plants backend/tests/integration -k 'archived or retention or history_access'

verify: Run required gates and attach output under .tasks/TASK-009/: archive retention access tests: pytest backend/tests/plants backend/tests/integration -k 'archived or retention or history_access'; memory bank lint: node scripts/mb-lint.mjs

Confirm task verification targets are satisfied: test:plant.lifecycle-archive-restore-retention; Archived Plants are excluded from normal operations and agent context retrieval; Retained artifacts remain accessible only to authorized actors
Validate listed constraints and invariants against the implementation and record any exception as a blocker before closure.
Run /verify and /red-verify before closure, record VERDICT: PASS and SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, and include HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done plus ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present as standalone evidence.
evidence_required: Tests proving archived Plants are excluded from normal operations and normal agent context retrieval
Tests proving retained history/photos/tasks/outcomes/timeline/admin audit remain available only to authorized actors
T3 human checkpoint and rollback/recovery note before closure
constraints: Archived Plants are excluded from normal Plant selector, check-in start, photo upload, measurement entry, normal agent context, task mutation, and physical-action approval paths
Archived Plants remain visible in admin/history views only to authorized actors
Archive must not invalidate old evidence refs
invariants: Plant archive never hard-deletes history, photos, tasks, outcomes, admin audit, or timeline evidence
Timeline/photo/manifest/export artifacts cannot overwrite Plant lifecycle authority
verification_targets: Archived Plants are excluded from normal operations and agent context retrieval
Retained artifacts remain accessible only to authorized actors
